question:
Direction: Out of the two bar graphs provided below, one shows the amounts (Rs. In Lakhs) invested by a company in purchasing raw materials over the years and the other shows the values (Rs. In Lakhs) of finished goods sold by the company over the years.

What was the difference between the average amount invested in raw materials during 1997 to 2000 and the average value of sales of finished goods during the same period 1997 to 2000?
question_hi:
निर्देश: नीचे दिए गए दो स्तंभ आलेखों में से, एक आलेख एक कंपनी द्वारा दिए गए वर्षों में कच्चा माल खरीदने में निवेश की गयी धनराशि (लाख रुपये में) को दर्शाता है और दूसरा दिए गए वर्षों में कंपनी के द्वारा तैयार वस्तुओं के विक्रय का मान (लाख रुपये में) दर्शाता है।

1997 से 2000 तक कच्चे माल में निवेशित औसत धनराशि और 1997 से 2000 तक की समान अवधि में तैयार वस्तुओं के विक्रय के औसत मान के बीच अंतर क्या है?
solution:
Average amount invested in raw materials during 1997 to 2000 = (375 + 330 + 525 + 420) /4 = 1650/4 = 412.5

Average amount of sales of finished goods during 1997 to 2000 = (500 + 400 + 600 + 460) /4 = 1960/4 = 490

Required difference = 490 – 412.5 = 77.5

question: If 10 men can complete a piece of work in 12 days by working 7 hours a day, then in how many days can 14 men do the same work by working 6 hours a day?
question_hi: यदि 10 पुरुष प्रतिदिन 7 घंटे काम करते हुए किसी काम को 12 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, तो प्रतिदिन 6 घंटे काम करते हुए 14 पुरुष समान काम को कितने दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं?
solution:
As we know,

Total work = M × H × D

M = Number of person, H = Number of the hour, D = Number of days,

Let the number of days be d, then

According to the question

10 × 12 × 7 = 14 × d × 6

D = (10 × 12 × 7)/(14 × 6)

D = 10 days
solution_hi:
जैसा कि हम जानते हैं,

कुल काम = M × H × D

M = व्यक्तियों की संख्या, H = घंटों की संख्या, D = दिनों की संख्या,

माना दिनों की संख्या d है, तो

प्रश्नानुसार,

10 × 12 × 7 = 14 × d × 6

D = (10 × 12 × 7)/(14 × 6)

D = 10 दिन

question: If 0 ≤ θ ≤ 90°, and sin (2θ + 50°) = cos (4θ + 16°), then what is the value of θ (in degrees)?
question_hi: यदि 0 ≤ θ ≤ 90° है, और sin (2θ + 50°) = cos (4θ + 16°) है, तो θ का मान क्या है (डिग्री में)?
solution:
sin (2θ + 50°) = cos (4θ + 16°)

sin (2θ + 50°) = sin [90° – (4θ + 16°)]

2θ + 50° = 90° – 4θ – 16°

2θ + 4θ = 74° – 50°

6θ = 24°

θ = 24°/6

θ = 4°

question: The monthly salary of a person was Rs. 50,000. He used to spend on three heads- personal and family expenses (E), taxes (T), philanthropy (P), and rest were his savings. E was 50% of the income, T was 20% of E and P was 15% of T. When his salary got raised by 40%, he maintained the percentage level of E, but T became 30% of E and P became 20% of T. By what percentage is the new savings more or less than the earlier savings? (correct up to one decimal place)
question_hi: एक व्यक्ति का मासिक वेतन 50,000 रुपये था। वह तीन जगह - व्यक्तिगत और पारिवारिक व्यय (E), कर (T), परोपकार (P) पर व्यय करता है और शेष उसकी बचत है। E आय का 50% था, T, E का 20% था और P, T का 15% था। जब उसके वेतन में 40% की वृद्धि होती है, वह E के प्रतिशत स्तर को बरक़रार रखता है, लेकिन T, E का 30% हो जाता है और P, T का 20% हो जाता है। नयी बचत पुरानी बचत से कितने प्रतिशत अधिक या कम है? (दशमलव के बाद दो अंकों तक पूर्णांकित)
solution:
Let total income of person be 100

E = 50

T = 50 × (20/100) = 10

P = 10 × (15/100) = 1.5

His savings = 100 - 50 - 10 - 1.5 = 38.5

His new salary = 100 × (140/100) = 140

E = 140 × (50/100) = 70

T = 70 × (30/100) = 21

P = 21 × (20/100) = 4.2

New savings = 140 - 70 - 21 - 4.2 = 44.8

His savings increased by = 44.8 - 38.5 = 6.3

His savings increased by (in%) = (6.3/38.5) × 100 = 16.4%

question: PQRS is a rectangle. T is a point on PQ such that RTQ is an isosceles triangles and PT = 5QT. If the area of ΔRTQ is 12√3 sq.cm, then the area of the rectangle PQRS is:
question_hi: PQRS एक आयत है। T, PQ पर एक बिंदु है जैसे कि RTQ एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज और PT = 5QT है। यदि ΔRTQ का क्षेत्रफल 12√3 sq.cm है, तो आयत PQRS का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
solution:
Given,

PT = 5QT

PT : QT = 5 : 1

Let the ratio of PT : QT be 5x : x.

PQ = PT + QT

PQ = 5x + x

PQ = 6x

PQ = RS [PQRS is a rectangle]

RS = 6x

In rectangle PQRS, there are three triangle ΔPST, ΔRTQ and ΔSTR

Area of ΔRTQ = 1/2 × Base × height

½ × x × RQ = 12√3

RQ = (12√3 × 2) /x

RQ = 24√3/x

Area of rectangle PQRS = ar ΔRTQ + ar ΔPST + ar ΔSTR

Area of rectangle PQRS = (1/2) × QT × RQ + (1/2) × PT × RQ + (1/2) × SR × RQ

Area of rectangle PQRS = (1/2) × RQ [QT + PT + SR] = (1/2) × (24√3/x) [x + 5x + 6x]

Area of rectangle PQRS = [12√3/x] × [12x] = 144√3 sq.cm

दिया गया है,

PT = 5QT

PT : QT = 5 : 1

माना,  PT : QT का अनुपात  5x : x होगा।

PQ = PT + QT

PQ = 5x + x

PQ = 6x

PQ = RS [PQRS एक आयत है।]

RS = 6x

आयत PQRS में, ΔPST, ΔRTQ और ΔSTR तीन त्रिभुज हैं।

आयत PQRS का क्षेत्रफल = [12√3/x] × [12x] = 144√3 sq.cm

question: 4 boys from school A and 6 boys from school B together can set up an exhibition in 5 days, which 5 boys from school A and 10 boys from school C together can do in 4 days or 3 boys from school B and 4 boys from school C together can do in 10 days. Then how many boys from school A can set up the exhibition in one day?
question_hi: विद्यालय A से 4 लड़के और विद्यालय B से 6 लड़के 5 दिनों में एक प्रदर्शनी लगा सकते हैं, जिसे विद्यालय A के 5 लड़के और विद्यालय C के 10 लड़के 4 दिनों में या विद्यालय B के 3 लड़के और विद्यालय C के 4 लड़के 10 दिनों में लगा सकते हैं। तो विद्यालय A के कितने छात्र एक दिन में प्रदर्शनी लगा सकते हैं?
solution:
As we know,

Total work of first group = total work of second group = total work of third group

(4A + 6B) × 5 = (5A + 10C) × 4 = (3B + 4C) × 10

(4A + 6B) × 5 = (3B + 4C) × 10

4A + 6B = 6B + 8C

4A = 8C

A : C = 8 : 4

A : C = 2 : 1     ...(1)

Again,

(5A + 10C) × 4 = (3B + 4C) × 10

20A + 40C = 30B + 40C

20A = 30B

A : B = 30 : 20

A : B = 3 : 2     ...(2)

From equation (1) and equation (2)

A : B : C : = 6 : 4 : 3

Total work = (4A + 6B) × 5 = (4 × 6 + 6 × 4) × 5 = 48 × 5 = 240

Let number of students from school A complete the work be x.

x × 6 = 240

x = 240/6

x = 40
solution_hi:
जैसा कि हम जानते हैं,

पहले समूह का कुल काम = दूसरे समूह का कुल काम = तीसरे समूह का कुल काम

(4A + 6B) × 5 = (5A + 10C) × 4 = (3B + 4C) × 10

(4A + 6B) × 5 = (3B + 4C) × 10

4A + 6B = 6B + 8C

4A = 8C

A : C = 8 : 4

A : C = 2 : 1     ...(1)

फिर से,

(5A + 10C) × 4 = (3B + 4C) × 10

20A + 40C = 30B + 40C

20A = 30B

A : B = 30 : 20

A : B = 3 : 2     ...(2)

समीकरण (1) और समीकरण (2) से

A : B : C : = 6 : 4 : 3

कुल काम = (4A + 6B) × 5 = (4 × 6 + 6 × 4) × 5 = 48 × 5 = 240

माना विद्यालय A के x छात्र काम को पूरा कर सकते हैं

x × 6 = 240

x = 240/6

x = 40

question: (320 + 342 + 530 + 915) ÷ (20 + 22 – x + 18) = 43, then the value of x is:
Which is the largest six-digit number, which when divided by 12, 15, 20, 24 and 30, leaves the remainders 8, 11, 16, 20 and 26 respectively.
question_hi: छह अंकों की वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जिसे यदि 12, 15, 20, 24 और 30 से विभाजित किया जाता है तो शेषफल क्रमशः 8, 11, 16, 20 और 26 प्राप्त होता है?

As we know,

(12 – 8) = (15 – 11) = (20 – 16) = (24 – 20) = (30 – 26) = 4

As we know,

6 digit largest number = 999999

So, number divisible by 120 = 999999 – 39 = 999960

Required number is = 999960 – 4 = 999956

question: The two parallel sides of a trapezium are 27 cm and 13 cm respectively. If the height of the trapezium is 8 cm, then what is its area in m<sup>2</sup>?
question_hi: एक समलम्ब की दो सामानांतर भुजाएँ क्रमशः 27 सेमी और 13 सेमी हैं। यदि समलम्ब की ऊंचाई 8 सेमी है, तो इसका क्षेत्रफल मी<sup>2</sup> में क्या है?
solution:
As we know,

Area of trapezium = (1/2) × (sum of parallel sides) × distance between parallel sides

Area of trapezium = (1/2) × (27 + 13) × 8 cm2

= (1/2) × 40 × 8 cm2

= 160 cm2

= 160/10000 m2

= 0.016 m2
solution_hi:
जैसा कि हम जानते हैं,

समलम्ब का क्षेत्रफल = (1/2) × (सामानांतर भुजाओं का योग) × सामानांतर भुजाओं के बीच की दूरी

समलम्ब का क्षेत्रफल = (1/2) × (27 + 13) × 8 सेमी2

= (1/2) × 40 × 8 सेमी2

= 160 सेमी2

= 160/10000 मी2

= 0.016 मी2

question: (4x<sup>3</sup>y - 6x<sup>2</sup>y<sup>2</sup> + 4xy<sup>3</sup> - y<sup>4</sup>) can be expressed as:

solution:
Short Trick:

(4x3y - 6x2y2 + 4xy3 - y4)

Put x = 0

⇒ 0 - 0 + 0 - y4

⇒ -y4

From option 1.

⇒ x4 - (x - y)4

⇒ 0 - (0 - y)4

⇒ -(-y)4

⇒ -(y)4

⇒ -y4

So, option 1 is right.

Detailed solution:

(4x3y - 6x2y2 + 4xy3 - y4)

⇒ 2xy3 - 2x2y2 - y4 + 4x3y + 2xy3 - 4x2y2

⇒ -y2 (-2xy + 2x2 + y2) + 2xy (2x2 + y2 - 2xy)

⇒ (2xy - y2) (2x2 + y2 - 2xy)

⇒ (x2 - x2 - y2 + 2xy) (x2 + x2 + y2 - 2xy)

⇒ [x2 - (x - y)2] [x2 + (x - y)2]

⇒ x4 - (x - y)4

(4x3y - 6x2y2 + 4xy3 - y4)

x = 0 मान रखते हैं

⇒ 0 - 0 + 0 - y4

⇒ -y4

विकल्प 1 से

⇒ x4 - (x - y)4

⇒ 0 - (0 - y)4

⇒ -(-y)4

⇒ -(y)4

⇒ -y4

अतः विकल्प 1 सही है।

विस्तृत हल:

(4x3y - 6x2y2 + 4xy3 - y4)

⇒ 2xy3 - 2x2y2 - y4 + 4x3y + 2xy3 - 4x2y2

⇒ -y2 (-2xy + 2x2 + y2) + 2xy (2x2 + y2 - 2xy)

⇒ (2xy - y2) (2x2 + y2 - 2xy)

⇒ (x2 - x2 - y2 + 2xy) (x2 + x2 + y2 - 2xy)

⇒ [x2 - (x - y)2] [x2 + (x - y)2]

⇒ x4 - (x - y)4

question: What is the HCF of 4/5, 6/8, 8/25?
solution:
HCF of 4/5, 6/8, 8/25 = HCF of numerator/LCM of denominator

HCF of 4, 6 and 8 = 2

LCM of 5, 8 and 25 = 200

HCF of 4/5, 6/8 and 8/25 = 2/200 = 1/100

question: The average run rate of a cricket team during the first 20 overs is 4.5. What should be the asking rate per over for the next 30 overs, if it has to chase a target of 282 runs in total?
question_hi: पहले 20 ओवर के दौरान एक क्रिकेट टीम का औसत रन रेट 4.5 है। यदि इसे कुल 282 रनों का पीछा करना है, तो अगले 30 ओवर के लिए आवश्यक रन रेट क्या होना चाहिए।
solution:
Total runs in 50 overs = 282

Average of runs in 20 overs = 4.5

Sum of run in 20 overs = 4.5 × 20 = 90

Runs need in remaining 30 overs = 282 - 90 = 192

Average runs in 30 overs = 192/30 = 6.4
solution_hi:
50 ओवर में कुल रन = 282

20 ओवर में औसत रन = 4.5

20 ओवर में रनों का योग = 4.5 × 20 = 90

30 ओवर में आवश्यक शेष रन = 282 - 90 = 192

30 ओवर में औसत रन = 192/30 = 6.4

question: A wheel has diameter 84 cm, then how far does the wheel go (in metres) in 16 revolutions? (Take π = 22/7)

Radius of the wheel = 84/2 = 42 cm

Circumference of the wheel = 2 πr = 2 × (22/7) × 42 = 264 cm

Distance covered by the wheel in 1 revolution = Circumference of the wheel

Distance covered by the wheel in 16 revolution = 16 × 264 = 4224 cm = 4224/100 m

= 42.24 m

question: A pole stands vertically on a road, which goes in the north-south direction. P, Q are two points towards the north of the pole, such that PQ = b, and the angles of elevation of the top of the pole at P, Q are α, β respectively. Then the height of the pole is:

h cot β = h cot α + b

h (cot β - cot α) = b

h = b/(cot β - cot α)

question: A clock tower stands at the crossing of two roads which point in the north-south and the east-west directions. In ΔQOK

question: Three pipes, A, B, C can fill an empty cistern in 2, 3 and 6 hours respectively. They are opened together. After what time should B be closed, so that the cistern gets filled in exactly 1 hr 15 min?

1 hr 15 min = 1 + 1/4 = 5/4 hr

Work done by A in 1 hr = 6/2 = 3

Work done by C in 1 hr = 6/6 = 1

Work done by A and C in 5/4 hr = (3 + 1) × 5/4 = 5 unit

Remaining work = 6 – 5 = 1

Pipe B work in 1 hr = 6/3 = 2 unit

Pipe B work in 30 min = 1 unit

So, the pipe should B be closed after 30 min.

1 घंटे 15 मिनट = 1 + 1/4 = 5/4 घंटे

question: While tabulation of marks scored in an examination by the students of a class, by mistake the marks scored by one student got recorded as 93 in place of 63, and thereby the average marks increased by 0.5. What was the number of students in the class?
question_hi: एक कक्षा के छात्रों द्वारा एक परीक्षा में प्राप्त अंकों की तालिका बनाते समय, एक छात्र के द्वारा प्राप्त अंक 63 की जगह 93 अंकित हो जाता है, और जिसके कारण औसत में 0.5 की वृद्धि होती है। कक्षा में छात्रों की संख्या क्या थी?
solution:
Short trick:

Required number of students = (93 - 63)/0.5 = 30/0.5 = 60

Detailed solution:

Let the total number of students be x and average marks of the students be y, then

According to the question

xy + 93 - 63 = x × (y + 0.5)

xy + 30 = xy + 0.5x

0.5x = 30

x = 30/0.5

x = 60
solution_hi:
छोटा तरीका:

छात्रों की अभीष्ट संख्या = (93 - 63)/0.5 = 30/0.5 = 60

विस्तृत हल:

माना छात्रों की संख्या x है और छात्रों के प्राप्तांक का औसत y है, तो

प्रश्नानुसार,

xy + 93 - 63 = x × (y + 0.5)

xy + 30 = xy + 0.5x

0.5x = 30

x = 30/0.5

x = 60

question: At what percentage rate, compound interest compounded annually for a sum of Rs. 40,000, will amount to Rs. 44,100 in two years?
question_hi: कितने प्रतिशत की दर से 40,000 रुपये की धनराशि 2 वर्षों में वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दर से 44,100 रुपये हो जाएगी?
solution:
Given:

P = 40,000 and A = 44,100 and t = 2 years

Calculation:

A = P (1 + r/100)t

⇒ 44,100 = 40,000 (1 + r/100)2

⇒ (1 + r/100)2 = 44,100/40,000

⇒ (1 + r/100) = √44,100/40,000

⇒ r/100 = 21/20 - 1

⇒ r/100 = 1/20

⇒ r = 5%

∴ The correct answer is 5%

question: The speed of two railway engines is in the ratio 5 : 4. If they move on parallel tracks in the same direction and if the slower engine is ahead of the faster engine by 8 km when the latter starts, then how far will the faster engine have to travel before it overtakes the slower one?
question_hi: दो रेल इंजन की गति का अनुपात 5 : 4 है। यदि सामानांतर पटरियों पर समान दिशा में चलते हैं और यदि धीमा इंजन तेज़ इंजन से 8 किमी आगे है जब दोनों प्रारंभ करते हैं, तो धीमे इंजन से आगे निकालने के लिए तेज़ इंजन को कितनी दूरी तय करनी होगी?
solution:
Speed ratio of two engines is = 5 : 4

Let the speed of the faster engine is 5 km/hr and speed of the slower engines is 4 km/hr

The distance of the two engines = 8 km

Required time to overtake by faster engine = 8/ (5 – 4) = 8 hr

Distance covered by the faster engine in 8 hrs = 5 × 8 = 40 km
solution_hi:
दो इंजन की गतियों का अनुपात = 5 : 4

माना तेज़ इंजन की गति 5 किमी/घंटा और धीमे इंजन की गति 4 किमी/घंटा है

दोनों इंजन के बीच की दूरी = 8 किमी

तेज़ इंजन द्वारा आगे निकालने के लिए आवश्यक समय = 8/ (5 – 4) = 8 घंटे

8 घंटे में तेज़ इंजन के द्वारा तय की गयी दूरी = 5 × 8 = 40 किमी

question: The ratio of two numbers is 3 : 5. If eight is added to the first, and seven to the second, then the ratio becomes 2 : 3. What will be the ratio becomes if six is added to each?
question_hi: दो संख्याओं का अनुपात 3 : 5 है। यदि पहली संख्या में आठ, और दूसरी संख्या में सात जोड़ा जाता है, तो अनुपात 2 : 3 हो जाता है। यदि दोनों संख्याओं में छह जोड़ा जाता है तो अनुपात क्या होगा?
solution:
Ratio of two number are = 3x : 5x

According to the question

(3x + 8)/(5x + 7) = 2/3

3 (3x + 8) = 2 (5x + 7)

9x + 24 = 10x + 14

10x - 9x = 24 - 14

x = 10

The first number = 3 × 10 = 30

Second number = 5 × 10 = 50

If 6 is added in each then new ratio = (30 + 6) : (50 + 6) = 36 : 56 = 9 : 14
